title: Whizz
overview:
One, Two, Three D!

Whizz takes you into the third dimension. 3D perspective Whizz is the new generation of game that all platform addicts have been waiting for!

Whizz the magician rabbit is racing his rival Ratty across magical worlds by hot air balloon. Guide Whizz through isometric levels to reach his balloon at the end before time runs out, jumping across gaps and spinning like a tornado to knock out enemies.

- Four themed worlds, from a beach to a land of playing cards, dice and chess pieces
- Red mushrooms restore health, but blue mushrooms hurt you
- Find keys to open doors, chests and cages, and grab hourglasses for extra time
- Launch all four rockets in a level to earn an extra continue
- Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty settings
